handoff.purpose: Source-located complete-scope USTC 2026 requirements bound only to exact closed program-intake records.

unresolvedNotes: This is a closed historical Fall 2026 route and must not be presented as a current application window.

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen with a valid passport and be in good physical and mental health.
Hold a senior-high graduation certificate equivalent to a Chinese high-school diploma by July 2026; a 2026 graduate may apply with a pre-graduation certificate.
Pass New HSK Level 5 or above; a native Chinese speaker or applicant with proof of Chinese-medium high-school study may request the published exemption.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants who emigrated from mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao or Taiwan
requirements.ruleText: Have obtained current foreign citizenship and renounced Chinese nationality before April 30, 2022, and have lived abroad for at least two years between April 30, 2022 and April 30, 2026 under the published nine-month rule.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants born abroad with one or two Chinese-citizen parents
requirements.ruleText: Provide qualifying proof of the Chinese parent's foreign permanent residence at the applicant's birth, proof that the applicant renounced Chinese nationality, or the applicant's PRC Foreign Permanent Resident ID Card.
Meet Ministry of Education Document No. 12 (2020).
Submit valid CSCA results with the online application: Professional Chinese (STEM) and Mathematics are compulsory, and either Physics or Chemistry must be selected.
Complete the online application from November 14, 2025 through March 31, 2026.
Submit the USTC Application Form for International Students (Undergraduate Program).
Submit a passport copy, including Chinese visa or residence-permit pages when applicable.
Submit notarized senior-high graduation certificate and transcripts; a prospective July 2026 graduate may submit a school-issued pre-graduation certificate and must present originals at registration.
Submit New HSK Level 5 certificate and score report, or qualifying proof of Chinese-medium high-school study; admitted applicants must present the original language records at registration.
Submit the Foreigner Physical Examination Form.
Submit an original Chinese- or English-language recommendation letter from the senior high school.
Submit the USTC Guardian Statement; the guardian must stay in Hefei during study and have a stable source of living.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants who emigrated from mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao or Taiwan
requirements.ruleText: Submit the immigration certificate, proof of cancellation of original Chinese citizenship, passport entry/exit-stamp pages and proof of living abroad for the published April 2022-April 2026 period.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants born abroad with one or two Chinese-citizen parents
requirements.ruleText: Submit one of the three published nationality-status documents supporting eligibility.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants with SAT, IB, GCE A-Level, ACT or AST results
requirements.ruleText: Optionally submit the score report; it is accepted only within two years of the examination date.
Complete any further test or interview requested after USTC evaluates the CSCA results and application materials.
Pay tuition of CNY 26,000 per academic year.
Pay the published CNY 800 annual insurance fee.
Budget CNY 500-1,000 per month according to room type and size.
Use the ordinary passport, Admission Notice, JW202 and original physical-examination records to obtain an X1 visa and register on the dates stated in the Admission Notice.

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen with a valid passport and be mentally and physically healthy.
Hold a bachelor's degree equivalent to a Chinese bachelor's degree.

requirements.appliesTo: Master applicants who have not yet received the qualifying degree
requirements.ruleText: Submit a pre-graduation certificate proving that the required degree will be completed by July 2026.
Be younger than 40 on September 1, 2026; individual scholarships may impose a lower age limit.
Pass New HSK Level 4 or above; a native Chinese speaker or applicant with proof of Chinese-medium high-school or university study may request the published exemption.
Complete the online application from October 16, 2025 through January 31, 2026.
A host supervisor does not need to be found before online application; complete applications are forwarded to the relevant schools and departments for review.
Submit an ordinary-passport copy with at least one year of validity.
Submit a study or research proposal of at least 1,000 words.
Submit a curriculum vitae.
Submit two recommendation letters from full or associate professors, including telephone number and email address.
Submit the Foreigner Physical Examination Form.
Submit degree certificate and academic transcripts for the bachelor's and, where applicable, master's stages, notarized by the national Ministry of Education or equivalent authority.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants currently enrolled at a university
requirements.ruleText: Submit official student-status evidence stating exactly when the qualifying degree certificate will be obtained.

requirements.appliesTo: Graduates who have not yet received the degree certificate
requirements.ruleText: Submit an official explanation stating why the certificate has not been issued and when it will be obtained.
Submit official evidence of on-post employment status and permission of release.

requirements.appliesTo: Documents not issued in Chinese or English
requirements.ruleText: Attach a notarized Chinese or English translation.
Understand that application materials are not returned regardless of the result.
Complete the school or department online assessment; all schools require an online interview and some also require an online entrance examination.
Pay the published CNY 800 annual insurance fee.
Budget CNY 500-1,000 per month according to room type and size.
Use the ordinary passport, Admission Notice, JW201/JW202 and original physical-examination records to obtain an X1 visa and register on the dates stated in the Admission Notice.
Pay tuition of CNY 30,000 per academic year.
